A triangle has two angles measuring 50° and 60°. What is the third angle?
Tổng ba góc trong một tam giác luôn bằng: The angles in any triangle always add up to 180°. So the third angle is 180° − (50° + 60°) = 70°.

1010₂ = 1×8 + 0×4 + 1×2 + 0×1 = 10. Mỗi: 1010₂ = 1×8 + 0×4 + 1×2 + 0×1 = 10. Each binary place is a power of 2.
